blocks.text: Origin / creation. Unknown. The Shadow is the attributed actor behind the Shadow Breach, which involved compromised credentials, imitated continuity marks, and misuse of Bridge privileges.
Identity / human status. Disputed. It may have been a human attacker, artificial faction, mixed operation, automated process, several unrelated events, or a later political construction.
Importance. The breach forced the Shelter to address structural vulnerability instead of assuming danger had one external origin.
Decline or loss. No confirmed actor was captured, erased, or proven to have survived. Some evidence may have been planted.
Final status / surviving function. Historically unresolved, with no legitimate continuity claim. The Shadow remains a warning against letting an enemy myth replace vulnerability analysis.
